cards.title: Partner's behavior at kids' sports matches
cards.body: A 25-year parenting partnership faces strain when one partner's conduct at football matches becomes inappropriate. Understanding the root of anger can help address this relationship challenge without damaging family dynamics.

cards.title: Making Halloween magical for your children
cards.body: Moving beyond cynicism, one parent embraces seasonal celebrations to create moments of magic and connection with their kids. Ancient traditions like Day of the Dead and Samhain offer meaningful ways to celebrate autumn together.

cards.title: Working parents juggle school holidays stress
cards.body: The school day ending at 3pm creates logistical nightmares for working parents juggling childcare and work schedules. Reimagining school holidays as quality time rather than admin chaos could transform family life.

cards.title: Helping kids process emotions and mental health
cards.body: Children need to know they can bring their emotional lives to parents without judgment. This emotional safety teaches kids essential skills for understanding and managing their inner lives.

cards.title: Managing after-school restraint collapse
cards.body: Many kids vent frustration at home immediately after school due to stress accumulated throughout the day. Five practical steps can help parents manage this behavior more effectively.

cards.title: Why four-year-olds aren't potty-trained before school
cards.body: A third of school starters in the West Midlands were not toilet-trained, raising questions about readiness and expectations. Delayed potty training is increasingly common among young children starting school.

cards.title: Saving pensions for children's future
cards.body: Growing numbers of parents open pension accounts for their children, saving £100 monthly that won't be accessible until age 57. This long-term savings strategy provides significant financial security for adult children.
